title: bind exact install/update approval to target package audit nonce expiry and policy

criteria: Exact approval binds actor, release object, target package, install/update operation type, AgentCore package reference, SecurityExecution envelope reference, audit sink, nonce, expiry, policy version, rollback baseline, and support/recovery references.
Approval does not imply execution and stale, broad, unsigned, mismatched, missing, replayed, or expired approvals fail closed.
No install, update, activation, rollback, support upload, recovery execution, remote dispatch, host boot mutation, or production ring mutation occurs.
